data.title: CBOT 25 Nov: soybean meal jumps about 2.4% before the Thanksgiving break
data.summary: At the New York close on Wednesday 25 Nov, CBOT soybean meal futures jumped 2.37%, soybeans rose 1%, corn gained 1.33%, wheat dipped 0.47% and soybean oil edged up 0.1%; US markets are shut on 26 Nov for Thanksgiving. Settlement prices were not yet published in sources reachable this run.

data.act: Lock Dec–Jan needs this week with at least two crushers holding bean stocks before they reprice to a CBOT meal price now near $350/st; a licence lapse at end-November would tighten local supply further.
data.why: CBOT meal extended its rally on 25 Nov, jumping about 2.4% at the close (Longbridge) after Dec settled $353.00 on 24 Nov (+$7.30, a five-week high) on NOPA's low 46.6 lb/bu meal yield; Jan soybeans rose another 1%. Pakistan still buys meal from local crushers only: import approvals were deferred on 23 Oct and current GM soybean licences run only through November 2026, with no renewal found as of 26 Nov.

data.refreshNote: Added a 25 Nov CBOT wrap (meal +2.4%, soybeans +1%) and refreshed the soybean meal view; maize page still shows 24 Nov, wheat 25 Nov is already in, rice rows are generic paddy, 25 Nov CBOT settlements could not be fetched (Brownfield and TFM pages failed, Farmbucks stale) and the 26 Nov interbank close is not out yet.
